sentence_stem: Even though the test was difficult,
full_sentence: Even though the test was difficult, most students passed it.
acceptable_variants: many students still achieved good marks.

options.why_wrong: 'Because' gives a reason, which conflicts with 'even though'; the sentence would need two connectors for one clause.
This is a consequence, not a contrast with the difficulty of the test.
This adds a description of the test but does not complete the contrast set up by 'even though'.

explanation: After 'even though', we need a clause that shows a result contrary to the difficulty mentioned in the first part. Learners sometimes add a cause connector after this structure, but English allows only one linking word for each clause, so the cause-based options are wrong.
translation: Mimo że test był trudny, większość uczniów go zdała.
